searchText: Basically `historical_summaries` has been added to the state object, https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/capella/beacon-chain.md#historicalsummary which will be better ongoing than `historical_roots` - its storing roots per epoch, which allows someone to validate they're the roots they're following in a fairly lightweight way. Thanks <@680234424037670912> 🙌 AFAIK, there is no such intent yeah i think better to just expose the beacon state (or block) root a la EIP-4788 What is the technical problem in doing this? I don't understand why wasn't this considered for Shanghai? no technical problem i wrote 4788 as it was going to be requisite for "pull"-style withdrawals and when we went down the "push" route, it became far less of a priority if someone had been championing it all along the way, it is possible it would have made it in for shanghai i personally would like to see 4788 and maybe 2537 in Deneb/Cancun Yeah would be very nice to have those two in so that we can verify information from the consensus chain.
